profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Leading high impact IT projects from inception through implementation to help organizations thrive is what I do. I am an extremely driven, collaborative professional who designs, delivers, and manages IT solutions with a focus on continuous improvement and quality.

I am energized to take on challenges and am committed to keeping projects on track for timely, efficient completions. I pride myself on being an agile strategist who takes ownership of the infrastructure and software development activities to support clients across various industries, including finance, healthcare, telecommunications, legal, and retail.

I also enjoy mentoring others and encouraging collaborative efforts toward a common goal.

To advance my knowledge and expertise, I have become a Certified Scrum Master. I have also completed graduate level coursework in Software Architecture, Information Security, & Software Engineering.


Areas of Expertise:  
Technology Projects  |  Process Improvements  |  Change Management  |  Software Development  |  Customer Satisfaction  |  Positive Client Relations  |  Relationship Building  |  Problem Solving  |  Agile Scrum Leadership  |  PM Scope and Schedule  |  API Services  |  Timely Project Delivery  |  Team Coaching  |  Time Management  |  Collaboration  |  Communications

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer | IT Consultant
positions.description:
Spearheaded IT solutions to meet evolving business needs in the financial services industry. Handled upgrades, modernizations, new feature creations, troubleshooting, and application support. Collaborated with a Scrum Team to deliver innovative software development projects in an agile environment.

► Steered efforts to bring systems from on-prem to the cloud
► Introduced a Scrum approach and automated testing by building systems to manage the work request for efficiently 
► Led many key process improvements, including the launch of peer reviews to eliminate the need for meetings to review code
► Created software tools to aid in wire transfer recovery, which enabled faster money transfers
► Used technologies, including Java Spring Boot, AWS, Docker, Oracle, Postgres, Hibernate, JPA, and Jenkins

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer | IT Consultant
positions.description:
Led a short-term project focused on building AGP endpoints for billing systems for an insurance and investment company. Specified the functionality of the endpoints, documented decisions, guided team activity, and utilized best practices to exceed customer expectations.

► Coordinated with backend services team to develop API user interface specifications, which initiated the roadmap for projects
► Developed API specifications and proxies using the Apigee API platform, Postman, Swagger editor, and open API Spec
► Handled DevOps, test automation, and cloud deployment with tools such as Jenkins, Git, and Maven

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Championed software development projects that enhanced communication with patients, saved significant time, and modernized the experience for both customers and physicians. Oversaw project dependencies, road mapping, testing, documentation, and delivery.

► Led a project that enabled patients to view their medical history and even download a PDF to quickly access their files
► Innovated and implemented a text messaging system that set reminders for appointments and bills
► Designed a medical record dictations solution to upgrade from the legacy system 
► Used validation tools to scan the patient portal website to confirm compliance with medical standards and regulations
► Developed web services to retrieve medical data using RESTAPI, and added functionality for XML and JSON data formatting
► Utilized C#/VB.Net, JavaScript, CSS, SQL, Azure, Twilio, DNN, MVC, Web API, XML, XSLT, and HTML

positions.title: Software Developer | eDiscovery Analyst
positions.description:
Managed new software developments, upgrades, reconfigurations, scrips, and other functions to support clients at a privately held legal services company.

► Built the Relativity system as a new migration and document processing system, and developed software in C# and SQL
► Developed and maintained an internal Git server to track software changes
► Managed the IT infrastructure systems and wrote perl scripts to manipulate data based off customer requests

positions.title: Information Center Specialist
positions.description:
Worked collaboratively, efficiently, and with attention to detail in a call center for a telecommunications company. Maintained applications, handled firewall and phone system configurations, oversaw active director administration, and assisted with other activities to meet client needs.

► Managed IP phones and campaign dialing using FreePBX, iSymphony, and OSdial, and wrote build procedures for Linux stations
► Integrated Windows Active Directory and Linux Identity Management System

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Spearheaded innovative, forward-thinking projects that led to increased profitability and customer satisfaction. Worked with a highly engaged, adaptable, and intellectually curious approach to deliver exciting new software, including timers, map displays, UI design, and touchscreen sensing.

► Contributed to the first commercial touch screen aviation system (G5000) while ensuring alignment with FAA regulations
► Developed embedded software in C language for aircraft computer systems
► Used Python for user interface testing, and used tools to ensure code coverage and execution of conditional statements
► Utilized Git and Borland StarTeam for software version control

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to major projects primarily through software maintenance. Served as an innovative, detail-oriented, agile team player.

► Developed software for Acision voice messaging systems using C/C++ and XML in a Linux environment 
► Integrated Agile processes during planning, sprint, and retrospective meetings
► Used SOAP and XML to communicate via RESTful API
